basis: results/props_results.json, 102 graded picks, Weeks 3-5, by market

stake.note: 1-5% bankroll scale set 2026-11-01 per Michael ($600 bankroll: 1%=$6 ... 5%=$30). Props capped at Tier 3 ($18).

confidence_bump.rule: +1 to base confidence when market rate >= 0.60 with graded >= 15

confidence_7_review.rule: confidence 7+ is capped at 6 until the 7+ tier shows >= 55% over 15+ graded

rank_gate.reason: no historical rank data; CBS season-to-date ranks include tested games

confidence_penalty.rule: -1 to base confidence for weak markets, plus an automatic 'against' factor showing the market's graded hit rate (computed live from results/props_results.json)
confidence_penalty.replaces: the old $0 track-only rule for rec_yards/receptions (changed 2026-10-13 per Michael)
